security_audit.summary: All 87 static matches are false positives for their stated patterns, including Markdown fences, validation helpers, Korean text, and test fixtures. The launcher introduces mutable npm execution and remote instruction trust, plus updates beyond this skill. No evidence found of credential exfiltration or malicious payloads in the six reviewed files; remote package behavior was not reviewed.

remediation.issue: The required launcher executes a floating npm release and elevates its output to primary skill instructions.
remediation.suggestion: Bundle the reviewed instructions and helper. Pin any required CLI to an exact, integrity-verified release and keep fetched text subordinate to trusted instructions.

remediation.issue: The update recommendation extends to every coding-agent skill installation, including unrelated skills.
remediation.suggestion: Remove global updates from the weather workflow. Offer scoped updates separately with explicit approval and a preview of affected installations.

content.user_title: Check Seoul Neighborhood Weather Risk Windows
content.value_statement: Neighborhood weather risks can affect visits, travel, and outdoor work across Seoul. This skill retrieves forecast-based risk windows using administrative neighborhood names without requiring user API keys.
actual_capabilities: Resolve names across a bundled reference of 427 Seoul administrative neighborhoods, with official names preferred over deterministic aliases.
Use district names to disambiguate duplicate neighborhoods and reject unsupported or vague location names.
Retrieve weather_place_risk_window data through a read-only proxy without user API keys or Authorization headers.
Query dates, times, page limits from 1 to 500, and publication-bound cursors through fast or full-contract workflows.
Inspect local configuration, catalog readiness, and product metadata; validate response envelopes and block redirects.
Retry an unavailable forecast window once using its overlap with the requested period, without inventing missing results.
limitations: Coverage is limited to one weather product and the bundled Seoul administrative neighborhood reference; fuzzy location matching is unavailable.
Risk windows use forecast thresholds and do not replace official Korea Meteorological Administration warnings.
Live queries depend on proxy availability, forecast coverage, permissions, quotas, and the current publication.
The documented launcher requires Node.js 18+ and executes a floating npm release; its remote behavior is outside the bundled Python audit.

use_cases.title: Plan Neighborhood Visits
use_cases.description: Check forecast risk periods for a named Seoul neighborhood before arranging a visit or journey.

use_cases.title: Review Outdoor Work Periods
use_cases.description: Inspect available weather risk windows for an administrative neighborhood and report coverage gaps before scheduling outdoor tasks.

use_cases.title: Inspect Weather Data Readiness
use_cases.description: Check product readiness, metadata, publication identifiers, and pagination behavior before using the available weather records.

prompt_templates.title: Check One Neighborhood
prompt_templates.prompt: Check today's weather risk windows for Jamsilbon-dong, using its official Korean administrative name. Use KST and explain that results are not official warnings.
prompt_templates.scenario: Beginner: retrieve one neighborhood's available forecast risks.

prompt_templates.title: Disambiguate a Location
prompt_templates.prompt: Check tomorrow's weather risk windows for Sinsa-dong. Ask which district I mean before querying, then report the available KST coverage.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: clarify a duplicate administrative neighborhood name.

prompt_templates.title: Review a Forecast Period
prompt_templates.prompt: Query Jamsilbon-dong for 2026-11-18, from 09:00 to 18:00 KST, with a 100-row limit. Report publication, row count, coverage, and any next-page cursor.
prompt_templates.scenario: Intermediate: inspect a defined period and page information.

prompt_templates.title: Diagnose and Page Results
prompt_templates.prompt: For Jamsilbon-dong, inspect preflight, catalog, and product metadata before querying the available forecast period. Page within one publication; stop on expiry or contract errors.
prompt_templates.scenario: Advanced: inspect the full contract and handle pagination failures.

output_examples.input: Check weather risks for Sinsa-dong without specifying a district.
output_examples.output: District required: Sinsa-dong exists in Gangnam-gu and Gwanak-gu. Specify the district before retrieving weather risk windows.

output_examples.input: Check weather risks for Seongsu-dong without an exact administrative neighborhood name.
output_examples.output: Location not resolved: Seongsu-dong is too broad for the administrative neighborhood reference. Provide the official administrative neighborhood name.

output_examples.input: Explain a query-window error when the requested period does not overlap the available forecast period.
output_examples.output: No overlapping forecast period is available. Review the available start and end times returned by the service; missing periods are not estimated.

best_practices: Use official Korean administrative neighborhood names and provide the district when a name is ambiguous.
Resolve relative dates to explicit KST periods and report publication identifiers, returned row counts, and actual coverage.
Use a reviewed, pinned launcher release and approve updates separately from weather queries.
anti_patterns: Do not present forecast-threshold candidates as official weather warnings or guarantees of safety.
Do not guess ambiguous locations, broaden partial names, or replace failed live queries with synthetic forecasts.
Do not paste credentials into prompts or run broad skill updates as part of a routine weather query.

faq.question: Do I need an API key?
faq.answer: No user API key is required. The helper uses a hosted proxy without an Authorization header and does not load local .env files.

faq.question: Which locations are supported?
faq.answer: The bundled reference covers 427 Seoul administrative neighborhoods. Use official Korean names or supported deterministic spelling variants, not broad area names.

faq.question: Why does Sinsa-dong require a district?
faq.answer: Sinsa-dong appears in both Gangnam-gu and Gwanak-gu. The helper requires a district rather than choosing a location arbitrarily.

faq.question: Are these official weather warnings?
faq.answer: No. The product identifies forecast-threshold candidates for heat, cold, heavy rain, heavy snow, and strong winds; official warnings remain separate.

faq.question: What happens when forecast coverage is unavailable?
faq.answer: The helper retries once for an overlapping available period when possible. Without overlap, it reports the error and available bounds instead of estimating results.

faq.question: What should I review before running the launcher?
faq.answer: The documented npm command uses a floating release and can supply remote instructions. Review and pin the dependency; approve unrelated updates separately.
